text:
maria: FYI - noticed our gpu-usage-daily ingest skipped ~24h (2024-06-16 -> 2024-06-17). Forecast pipeline shows ~-20% GPU hours which caused Dedicated autoscaler to under-commit.
raj: source of truth for that gap?
jess: Logs or dashboard screenshot?
maria: Collector shows 5xx responses in the window. Example from the collector logs: ```curl -v https://telemetry.redwood/sink -H 'x-api-key:***' -> 503 Service Unavailable```
leo: ops-bot recorded an S3 permissions rotation at 2024-06-16T03:14Z and a kinesis consumer restart 03:20Z. Could be related to temporary write failures to archive.
sara: Was there a schema change from eng-ml last week? a schema bump would generate 422s (we'd reject), not 503.
maria: Right — collector shows 503/timeout, not 422. So likely network/ingest endpoint overload or intermediate permission issue.
raj: Cloud provider had a minor networking maintenance in us-west1 around that window per their status page — packet drops and elevated 5xx for some customers.
jess: Action plan: 1) backfill raw events for the 24h gap, 2) re-run ETL + reforecast, 3) tighten telemetry alerting and add retry-with-jitter on the collector, 4) add a short-term fallback to ingest-archive if primary sink is failing.
maria: Backfill note: raw stream archive lives in s3://ingest-archive-usw/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}. I can trigger the backfill job that replays to the ETL — ETA ~45m.
leo: For the forecasting model we should pin metric definitions explicitly in the pipeline docs. Current defs we rely on:
- `gpu_hours` = sum(gpu_time_seconds)/3600 across job_type where status != cancelled
- `avg_throughput_rps` = sum(tokens_generated)/sum(wall_time_seconds)
- `active_nodes` = count(distinct instance_id) over window
- smoothing: 7d exponential smoothing alpha=0.2
tony: Also encode seasonality flags: weekly (workday vs weekend), quarterly spikes (customer benchmarking / demos), and month-end reserved capacity renewals.
sara: Add ingest monitoring metrics: `ingest_drop_reason` (tag: 503/422/timeout), `ingest_lag_seconds` (time between event timestamp and ETL write). Dashboards should pivot by region + model_family.
maria: New alerts proposal: trigger if p95(ingest_lag_seconds, 1h) > 120s OR count(ingest_drop_reason==503, 1h) > 10. Also auto-create a backfill ticket if gap > 6h.
raj: Once backfill completes, I will run two forecast scenarios: (A) naively include the backfilled data, (B) simulate missing day to show provisioning delta. We need to quantify how much capacity we under-provisioned.
jess: After you run the reforecast, post numbers and recommended capacity change to #eng-infra and tag @oncall. Also update the infra runbook steps under "incomplete-ingest" with exact playbook.
ops-bot: deployment job #deploy-telemetry-229 finished (success) at 2024-06-17T05:02Z
maria: ok I'll kick off backfill now and post progress here. If anyone wants to pair on the ETL re-run, ping me.
raj: will help with the forecast runs. thanks.
